notes.title: Post Launch Fixes & New Content!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Convicts,[/h1]

Happy Breakout launch week! As part of the first update there are a number of changes coming, from quality of life fixes to new content. Feedback has been sent in and heard, and a lot of elements of the game have been reevaluated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355739/fae5d3b43cb8c64b8cb3c8cc5102235633fdfa5a.png[/img]

[h2]New Rooms:[/h2]
With this update, two new rooms have been added:
[list]
[*]A large cell room featuring a giant window just begging to be jumped through, available in the Cells theme from the start
[*]An open energy siphoning vat with platforms connected by energy bridges above a deadly sea of energy liquid, available in the Tech theme from room 70 onwards
[/list]
The rooms have new Datapads to be found, each of which unlocks a new Log in the Robodex. Access the Robodex from the pause menu to have a look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355739/f75901eb9de3b0f7d363f319ccffbdda931552e2.png[/img]

[h2]New Story Content[/h2]

Also in this update, there are some additional story cutscenes:
[list]
[*]A new cutscene when launching a new game from the main menu (note: this will not play when restarting from the pause menu or death screen, only from the main menu)
[*]A vignette when entering the first boss room, the wave-based Isolation Cells Security Door
[/list]
As previously mentioned, the Robodex now contains new entries in the Logs section. Find their respective Datapads in each of the new rooms to gain a greater understanding of the world around you.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

With that said, here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*]Added a new cutscene when starting a new game
[*]Added a new introduction area to teach controls & mechanics
[*]Added two new rooms, one each for the Cells and Tech themes
[*]Added FPS settings to the settings menu
[*]Added V-Sync settings to the settings menu
[*]Added a Field of View slider to the settings menu (note: only applies during gameplay)
[*]Controls reference now shows on the main menu's settings menu
[*]Lowered boss room number to every 40 rooms
[*]Removed infinite spawners in early Cells themed rooms
[*]Allowed Hydro themed rooms to be visited earlier
[*]Allowed Tech themed rooms to be visited earlier
[*]Reduced damage of the Plasma bot cannons
[*]Fixed door audio not playing when entering Isolation Cells Security Door boss
[*]Fixed lifts locking the player in place while moving down
[*]Scrap crawler & Scrap limper optimisations
[*]Magnet boss optimisations
[*]Reduced Magnet boss health
[*]Reworked Magnet boss movement
[*]Better collision detection to prevent being pushed out of rooms
[*]Better reset point used if pushed out of bounds
[*]Various other small fixes
[/list]

If you find any bugs, issues or have general thoughts, feel free to contact the [url=mailto:breakoutsupport@proton.me]Breakout email[/url]
